title: Base change of a free module is free
statement: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings and $F$ a free $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-free-module] with basis $(e_i)_{i\in I}$. Then $A\otimes_RF$ is a free $A$-module, with basis $(1\otimes e_i)_{i\in I}$; the same holds for $F\otimes_RA$ with basis $(e_i\otimes1)_{i\in I}$ (the two are identified by the $A$-linear isomorphism $a\otimes x\mapsto x\otimes a$).
